enchantments.tooltip: +2 Enhancement Bonus: +2 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.
Fortification +59%: +59% Enhancement bonus to reduced chance of taking critical damage on a critical hit.
Seeker +4: Provides a +4 Enhancement bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +4 Enhancement bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Physical Sheltering +9: +9 Enhancement bonus to Physical Resistance Rating
Parrying +1: +1 Insight bonus to Armor Class, +1 Insight bonus to Saves.
Mythic Armor Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
